# Declarative Forms

> Forms as Code: keep a YAML form definition in your GitHub repository; Declarative Forms renders it and handles submissions.

Create or edit the YAML in the user's repository, or return complete YAML when
file editing is unavailable. The hosted service reads public GitHub repositories.
After the file is committed and pushed, open
`https://frms.dev/<owner>/<repo>/<path-without-.yaml>`. The branch defaults to
literal `main`; use `?branch=<URL-encoded-name>` for another pushed branch.

## References

- [Create and publish a form](https://frms.dev/docs): Shared quick start for manual authoring and coding agents, URL conventions, validation, and preview checks.
- [JSON Schema](https://frms.dev/schema.json): Maintained draft-07 authoring schema with supported keys, constraints, descriptions, and examples. Validate parsed YAML with an available JSON Schema validator; syntax checking alone is insufficient.
- [YAML reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/declarativeforms/core/main/SCHEMA.md): Human-readable field and validator explanations, examples, and runtime caveats. Also useful for behavior the schema cannot check.

## Examples

- [Contact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/declarativeforms/core/main/examples/contact.yaml): A compact single-section form.
- [Team lunch RSVP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/declarativeforms/core/main/examples/lunch-rsvp.yaml): Choices, conditional visibility, and a completion message.
- [Kitchen sink](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/declarativeforms/core/main/examples/kitchen-sink.yaml): All supported field types and advanced features.

## Authoring checks

Use unique field and section identifiers, check navigation targets and cycles,
and verify expression and template references. Keep secrets out of definitions;
only configure delivery destinations supplied by the user. Schema validation
does not execute expressions or test delivery. Preview the pushed form and
report checks that could not be performed. Do not claim a local file is live.

## Project

- [Source](https://github.com/declarativeforms/core): Open source under AGPL-3.0; self-hosting is an optional deployment choice.
